request_flow.summary: Publish a draft with approval, priced components and separate promotion provenance. Product prices and allocations are data.
Authorize the operation and both sessions, read the effective version and bind the requested language and approved disclosure ID to the exact terms.

Lock the operation quote, both Privacy scopes and the exact offer. For Assessment-bearing products, check the active claim, Entitlements and Temperament. Commit Purchase, accepted quote and any claim together.
Apply qualified payment and the open consequence in Commerce. Each TEST Assessment grant and its acknowledgement runs in a separate transaction.
E2a-style attribution uses the accepted versioned component after repricing. The existing scoped correction path can end only that component's right.

E2a acknowledges the exact Assessment correction after Entitlements commits its effect. Recovery can settle an original paid consequence even when that correction prevented the grant. The original accepted snapshot and both effect identities remain durable.

security_invariants.summary: Opaque identifiers cannot substitute for signed operation authority and current verified canonical sessions. Owner review exposes only a quote finding.

Identity reconciliation requires each owning Domain to review its scope. Existing unapplied reviews must obtain current owner evidence after the Temperament owner joins; applied decisions retain their history.
Commerce reads ordinary-credit and successful-delivery evidence under the Privacy subject lock. Premium evidence and Plan-only eligibility remain independent.
Private Ash policies deny direct caller access. S1 authority producers and payable proof run in TEST. The P1 scheduler, legacy E2a grant and S1 TEST grant have distinct scopes.

concurrency.summary: Identity locks canonical accounts in stable order. The quote row write lock and offer shared lock serialize acceptance with replay or catalogue changes. Privacy scope locks serialize admission with owner credit updates.
The partial unique active-recipient index backs arbitration. One quote identity per operation and one Purchase per quote bind exact replay.

idempotency_retry.summary: Exact acceptance replay returns the original Purchase, attempt, timestamp and terms after promotion change or repricing. A request with changed evidence or parties cannot replay it.
Payment, owner grant and acknowledgement each converge on their own source identity. A lost acknowledgement leaves the claim active until fresh recovery finds exact owner evidence.
A delivered correction and its admission acknowledgement each keep their first completion. Replay on an earlier purchase cannot release a later recipient claim.

failure_recovery.summary: Insert failure after proposed Purchase rolls back the purchase, quote decision and claim together. At commit PostgreSQL verifies the complete purchase, quote, allocation and applicable recipient claim.

An unpaid claim remains active unless qualified irreversible nonpayability is recorded. A paid claim stays active until a terminal Entitlements outcome. Unresolved evidence, an acknowledged Plan correction, and a final Assessment correction with pending acknowledgement cannot settle an absent Assessment grant.
Rollback restores both legacy constraints only when accepted versioned history is absent. Existing P1 and E2a source identities survive both migration directions.

safe_extensions.summary: S2 can use the exact accepted snapshot and replace bounded adapters with authorized owner facts and provider evidence. Keep the same acceptance and payment obligation identities.

reuse.summary: Commerce extends the P1 Purchase, verified payment and consequence actions. Store checkout version reentry and Order's unique checkout key inform operation identity while the AshPostgres conditional upsert preserves immutable replay.

Store's create-only SnapshotWriter, allocation set, component amounts and PostgreSQL commit proofs inform the NewYou typed offer columns and complete acceptance constraint. Fixed Assessment and Plan components fit one immutable offer row linked to the quote.

prohibited_shortcuts.summary: Do not accept a different offer on replay or compute a historical refund from current prices. Remain fenced on incomplete or ambiguous money and owner evidence.
Do not route S1 to P1 or legacy E2a grant execution. Store tax, stock, shipping, subscription and provider rules are outside this scope.

proof_limitations: S1 is bounded TEST admission and recovery. There is no provider I/O, actual sale, checkout UI, production delivery evidence or full three-product materialization.
The approved synthetic amounts and both disclosure IDs are fixture evidence. Launch pricing and exact commercial copy require governed approval.
Store source inspection informs patterns. The Store tests were read rather than executed.
